reason: The hypothesis combines the W-Cu composite system and its 3D copper network concept (P1-P4) with the laser-induced copper reflow and densification mechanism from diamond/Cu coatings (P5-P7) to propose a post-sintering laser treatment for W-Cu composites, a combination not suggested in any passage. However, the mechanism is taken almost word-for-word from the diamond/Cu studies, and the predicted outcome directly mirrors the 8.92% improvement reported in P5, making the core idea a straightforward transfer of a known laser treatment to a new composite system with minimal new mechanistic insight.
copied_elements: laser-induced plastic deformation and re-melting of Cu to improve density and thermal conductivity (P5, P6, P7)
formation of a continuous three-dimensional copper network for electron/phonon transport (P1, P3, P4)
~8-10% thermal conductivity improvement from laser treatment (P5)
W-Cu composite fabrication by chemical plating and sintering (P1, P2, P3, P4, P16, P17)
